hook_en: His word will never fail you. 🙏
reflect_en: Plans shift and promises get broken, but God's way is perfect and His word is flawless. Whatever you're facing today, He is a shield for you when you take refuge in Him.
q_en: What are you asking God to shield you from today?
x_en: the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
tiktok: His word is flawless 🙏 Psalm 18:30–31 — He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him
yt_title: The Word of the LORD Is Flawless | Psalm 18:30-31 #Shorts
li_open: People follow leaders whose word holds up.
li_quote: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
li_body: God's word never fails, and that is the foundation we lead from. When we keep our word to the people we serve, following up on the prayers we promised to pray, we reflect a little of His faithfulness to them.
reflect_es: Los planes cambian y las promesas humanas se rompen, pero el camino de Dios es perfecto y Su palabra es pura. Hoy Él es tu escudo si esperas en Él.
q_es: ¿De qué le estás pidiendo a Dios que te proteja hoy?
x_es: es acendrada la palabra de Jehová: escudo es a todos los que en él esperan.
key_en: the word of the LORD is flawless
key_es: escudo es a todos los que en él esperan
